subject: Compact remit chains & cost-center allocation for multi-entity invoice
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@novahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Invoice splitting & partial remit: Nova Health PO 7834

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we're moving forward with the pilot and I need help with how Redwood will issue invoices for PO 7834. Nova Health will pay from two legal entities (NovaHealth EU Ltd and NovaHealth US Inc) and they want the invoice to be split 60/40 across cost centers. Additionally, the EU entity will remit only part of the total initially (partial payment), with the remainder to follow next month.

Questions:
- Can Redwood issue a single invoice with per-line remit instructions, or do we need two separate invoices?
- We need VAT to be shown on the EU-leg portion and zero-rated on the US-leg.
- Is there a preferred field to carry "cost_center" tags so our AP system can auto-allocate?

I've attached PO_7834.pdf. Our AP team will expect Net30 after final invoice. Copying procurement and AP here.

Appreciate a quick note on the recommended flow so we can align internal routing.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Sr. Procurement Manager
Nova Health

Attachment: PO_7834.pdf

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procure@novahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice splitting & partial remit: Nova Health PO 7834

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear note and the PO. Short answer: we can accommodate a compact remit chain that preserves a single invoice number while exposing per-line remit targets and tax treatment, which usually causes the least friction for customers' AP systems. That said, there are trade-offs (see below).

Proposed next steps:
1) Redwood to prepare a draft invoice in our split_template format with per-line cost_center tags and remit-to instructions for EU vs US.
2) You confirm the exact remittance accounts for (a) NovaHealth EU Ltd and (b) NovaHealth US Inc and the partial amount the EU entity will remit initially.
3) We'll send draft INV-2026-0543-draft.pdf for signoff; final will be posted to your accounting-eu@novahealth.com and payment routed per line.

Trade-offs: single-invoice + remit instructions (recommended)
- Pros: single accounting document, easier for reseller/finance reconciliation, keeps sequence numbers intact.
- Cons: some AP systems expect one remit-to per invoice; they may need a mapping step.

Separate invoices per entity
- Pros: mirrors legal entity boundaries clearly; simpler tax reporting per invoice.
- Cons: more documents to reconcile; PO references can get messy.

Cc'ing Ben (billing) and Karthik (tax) to weigh in on the operational flow and VAT handling. I'll attach our split_template so you can see the fields.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: split_template.xlsx

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Invoice splitting & partial remit: Nova Health PO 7834

Ben / Karthik — forwarding Liam's PO and his ask. Key constraints: EU needs VAT on its share, will do a partial remit first (approx 60% of total) and the US entity covers remaining 40% later. Procurement would prefer we keep a single invoice if we can set per-line remit tags and a cost_center code that maps to their GL.

Questions for you both:
- From billing ops perspective, can we emit one invoice with two remit-to lines and still support partial payment allocation in our collections workflow?
- From tax perspective, is there any issue showing VAT-only on the EU line while marking the US line as out-of-scope?

If it's easier I'll draft a two-line invoice mock and run it through our Collections/AR to confirm acceptance.

Thanks,
Grace

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 11:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Invoice splitting & partial remit: Nova Health PO 7834

Grace — we can do the single-invoice approach. Operational notes below: 

1) Invoice structure: single invoice (INV-2026-0543) with two invoice lines. Each line will have: description, gross amount, tax_amount (VAT where applicable), remit_to_account tag, and a cost_center custom field. Our AR system will accept partial payments with allocation rules keyed by remit_to_account.

2) Partial payment flow: when EU remits the initial 60%, our bank reconciliation will match the payment to remit_to_account = "NovaHealth EU Ltd" and allocate proportionally to the EU line(s). Remaining 40% can be settled by the US entity against the same invoice. We'll need the exact IBAN / bank reference per remit_to and preferred payment reference.

3) VAT and tax accounting: Karthik, from a tax ledger perspective we should post VAT on the EU-line invoice row and mark the US row as non-VAT. That will create separate tax events for reporting — OK to proceed if the customer confirms the legal entity names and VAT numbers.

4) AP routing: recommend the invoice PDF contain clear "Remit instructions" blocks and a machine-readable cost_center tag (e.g., CC: 54321) so their ERP can auto-split. We'll also add a single-line CSV export for their AR import.

I'll prepare the draft invoice and the CSV template. Grace — can you ask Liam for the bank details and the exact initial remit amount? I'll attach the draft template here.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Billing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: INV-2026-0543-draft.pdf

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novahealth.com>

Subject: Re: Invoice splitting & partial remit: Nova Health PO 7834

Thanks Grace / Ben — that flow works for us. Confirming details below:

- Initial EU remit: 60% of total (EUR 36,000). Remit-to: NovaHealth EU Ltd, IBAN: GB33NWBK60161331926819, VAT ID: GB123456789.
- Remaining 40% by NovaHealth US Inc (USD equivalent) after we process internal approvals. Remit-to: NovaHealth US Inc, Account: 123456789, Routing: 011000015.
- Our AP team prefers the invoice PDF to include per-line "Remit to" blocks and a CSV for automated ingest. Please send the final invoice to accounting-eu@novahealth.com and cc procure@novahealth.com. Net30 from the final invoice date.

One small ask: can Redwood include a "cost_center" tag on each line (we'll map CC 54321 => Clinical Trials / CC 76543 => Research Ops). If you include CC tags, our ERP will auto-apply the split and speed payment.

If you send the draft today we should be able to sign off by tomorrow.

Best,
Liam
Sr. Procurement Manager
Nova Health
